reason: I already do card and phone tricks and I have a family dinner every Friday, so a Hebrew phone mind-reading kit is exactly the kind of thing I'd pull out at the table. I'd try the free tricks on Thursday night and if one fooled my wife, 99 shekels once is easy for me.
objection: If the trick glitches or the reveal looks fake in front of the whole family, I look like an idiot, and I've bought magic apps before that worked great in the demo and clunky in real life. Also, paying by card on some website that isn't the App Store makes me a bit wary.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks feel clumsy or obviously app-like when I test them, I wouldn't pay for the rest.
